hooks.logic:
Let container be the group of the enemy.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then set the register's 'withoutAbilityForMeteor' to true.
If condition flag "countup_turn" is up this frame, then increase the register's 'countUpTurn' by one.
If the register's 'multipleAttackCnt' is more than 1 and condition flag "countup_turn" is up this frame, then
  Let v be call helper4 with (this state).
  If the enemy → has-ability-tag with ("meteor") and v is the id of the move labelled "meteor" on the enemy, then set the register's 'withoutAbilityForMeteor' to true.
  The enemy uses v immediately with options {} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
  If the register's 'withoutAbilityForMeteor', then increase the register's 'withoutAbilityTurn' by one.
  Stop.
If call helper2 with (this state) is not the register's 'currBpIdx' and call helper with (this state), then
  Call helper3 with (this state).
  Set the register's 'countUpTurn' to 0 and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'withoutAbilityTurn' is more than the numeric entry "meteor_interval_turn" in the battle settings of container, then
    Set the register's 'withoutAbilityTurn' to 0.
    Set the register's 'withoutAbilityForMeteor' to false.
  The enemy uses call helper4 with (this state).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
Let v be call helper2 with (arg).
Let v2 be list at v.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form v2's 'paramSuffixNo' on executer.
Executer changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
Executer cancels its cast.
Set globalRegister's 'multipleAttackCnt' to v2's 'multipleAttackCnt'.
Set globalRegister's 'currBpIdx' to v.
